prayerExcerpt.en-US: In the cause of justice and truth, prudence should not be held in account; otherwise prudence is mere human respect.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Na causa da justiça e da verdade, a prudência não deve ser levada em conta; do contrário, a prudência é mero respeito humano.

meta.face: A Roman of about fifty with a warm olive complexion and an OBLONG face — prominent, ROUNDED cheekbones that lift when he smiles, a broad, straight nose, dark-brown eyes that CRINKLE at the corners under softly arched dark brows, deep SMILE LINES, and a notably WIDE, generous mouth with full lips in an open, warm smile; short, dark, CURLY hair greying at the temples; a short, rounded dark beard with grey at the chin; his gaze warm and direct.
meta.basis: No likeness survives, and the Catholic Encyclopedia finds his Acts 'of no historical value'. The book makes him a Roman priest who helped the martyrs under Claudius II and was beheaded about 270, with a church near the Ponte Mole on the Flaminian Way; its engraving shows him bearded, saying Mass in a prison. Hence the priest's dress, the beard and the Flaminian setting; the broad, smiling face is our choice.
